title: River Client 0.3.2
items: Improved: The Windows installer is back to about 230 MB instead of 1 GB. It carries River for Minecraft 1.21.11; other versions download the first time you play them.
Improved: The Mac and Linux downloads are smaller for the same reason.
Added: The standalone mod updates itself. It downloads the new version in the background, checks it is a real River release, and switches to it the next time you start Minecraft.
Fixed: With FancyMenu installed, River's main menu no longer covers FancyMenu's custom menus.
Changed: Every River player now has the River badge, and it is smaller, the height of the letters next to it. Cinematic mode hides everyone's badges on your screen; other players still see yours.
Changed: The None card in Cosmetics shows River's red X.
Improved: Security. Links only ever open as web pages, the launcher window can no longer be sent to a website, and file actions stay inside River's own folders.
